system.description:
"Teleportation doesn't suck."

Limitations: There is a 10-second delay before the effect takes place.

You and up to 3 party members of your choice teleport to another location. Everyone feels a tingling sensation while waiting for the effect to resolve.

upgrades.description: The delay is 2 seconds, and the destination doesn't have to be a surface.
The delay is 1 second, and the destination can be anywhere within 1,000 yards in any direction, even if the exact destination cannot be seen.
There is no delay, and the destination can be anywhere within 1 mile in any direction, even if the exact destination cannot be seen.
